author: Shri Nisargadatta Maharaj
quote: Wisdom tells me I am nothing. Love tells me I am everything. Between the two, my life flows.

author: Buddha
quote: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.

author: Buddha
quote: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.

author: Chief Seattle
quote: The earth does not belong to man; man belongs to the earth. All things are connected like the blood which unites one family.

author: Chief Seattle
quote: Teach your children what we have taught our children: that the earth is our mother. Whatever befalls the earth befalls the sons of the earth.

author: African Proverb
quote: What we do to the land, we do to ourselves.

author: Rumi
quote: You were born with wings, why prefer to crawl through life?

author: Rumi
quote: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.

author: Rumi
quote: Love is the bridge between you and everything.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
quote: Walk as if you are kissing the Earth with your feet.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
quote: The most precious gift we can offer anyone is our attention. When mindfulness embraces those we love, they will bloom like flowers.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
quote: To be beautiful means to be yourself. You don’t need to be accepted by others. You need to accept yourself.

author: Thich Nhat Hanh
quote: Understanding someone’s suffering is the best gift you can give another person.

author: Supreme Master Ching Hai
quote: The world needs love, peace, happiness and a plant-based diet. We should be kind to all living beings.

author: Supreme Master Ching Hai
quote: Animals have souls; they feel pain and joy just like us.

author: Supreme Master Ching Hai
quote: Be kind to every living thing, for kindness is the essence of spirituality.
